full_judgment: 10. Having gone through the decisions and we find substance in the argument of Mr. Attorney General and therefore we hold that the suit land being within the periphery of hats and bazar have been vested in the Government in such view of the matter, the findings and decisions arrived at by the High Court Division can not be sustained in law. We therefore hold that the decree in respect of the suit land declaring title (jote right of the plaintiffs) thereto can not be sustained in view of the provision of Section 20 (2a) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1951. The learned Single Judge having failed to apply his judicial mind misdirected himself in affirming the decrees of the Courts below. Since the suit land is within the Shahidpur bazar, the plaintiffs cannot retain this as his khas land as the same has already vested in the Government with effect from the date of notification 1956 tinder wholesale acquisitions under Section 3(2) of the said Act.
